name: Radon Eye BLE Sensors
description: The `radon_eye_rd200` sensor platforms lets you track the output of Radon Eye RD200 Bluetooth Low Energy device.

config_entries.label: BLE Hub ID
config_entries.description: The BLE tracker hub to receive advertisements from. Auto-generated when only one tracker is configured; set it explicitly to disambiguate multiple trackers. Replaces the former `esp32_ble_id` key, which still works as a deprecated alias until ESPHome 2027.2.0.
